exact_statement: For every fixed integer d >= 3, every N-point subset of R^d determines N^(2/d-o(1)) distinct distances as N tends to infinity.
scope_notes: The public statement, source, sole success condition, and non-success conditions are copied exactly from erdos-1083-moment-round4.
Round four remains frozen and is inherited only as negative evidence: normalized unit-blind data do not determine collision behaviour when the common source is translated.
Round five fixes the common source X before measuring relative Laurent-unit fibres; the round-four translation pair cannot be reused as a fixed-X adversary.
Promotion requires a rigorous dimension-three exponent strictly greater than 3/5, including full-target propagation, occurrence mass, fibre and stability interfaces.
